name: Sainnth

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero, father of Macha in some texts
an otherworldly woman forced to race the king's horses
the province whose men Macha's fate cursed

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sainnth is an Irish hero. In some texts he is the father of Macha. Macha was an otherworldly woman whom the king forced to race his horses. She was heavy with child at the time. Against her plea the race went on. She beat the king's swift team and gave birth to twins at the finish line. The effort killed her, so the gods tied that loss to Ulster. Little else is known of Sainnth. He appears in the record only as the father of that racing goddess.
objective: Document Sainnth, the Irish hero and father of Macha.
